description: Composite EBSD figure of the Fe-35Mn-15Al-5Cu (at.%) "15Al" low-density steel, tiled as six panels, each containing an inverse pole figure (IPF) map (left; cubic 001/101/111 colour-key triangle) paired with its phase map (right). The identical legend in every panel reads BCC = red, α-Mn = blue, β-Mn = green, FCC = magenta. (a1) and (a2) are the 525 °C/3 h condition: (a1) low-magnification, 100 µm scale bars, the phase map is nearly uniformly green (β-Mn) with only sparse red; (a2) the 5 µm magnified view shows green β-Mn with red islands arrowed "α". (b1)/(b2), 550 °C/6 h, 200 µm and 5 µm scale bars: (b1) IPF shows coarse grains and the phase map is green with fine red speckles; (b2) the magnified phase map is green β-Mn with an elongated red network arrowed "New BCC phase". (c1)/(c2), 650 °C/3 h, 200 µm and 5 µm scale bars: (c1) IPF shows large grains plus an unindexed white band at left, phase map green with sparse magenta speckles; (c2) the magnified phase map is dominated by a red/salmon matrix with scattered magenta particles arrowed "New FCC phase" — the caption instead calls this matrix β-Mn, so the base colour disagrees with the stated phase identity. Overall the panels document the α → β-Mn transformation plus late BCC and FCC precipitation during aging.

observations.observation: Every sub-panel carries the same phase legend: BCC = red, α-Mn = blue, β-Mn = green, FCC = magenta.
Each IPF map is accompanied by the standard cubic inverse-pole-figure colour key triangle labelled 001, 101 and 111 at its corners.
Scale bars differ by magnification: 100 µm in (a1), 200 µm in (b1) and (c1), and 5 µm in the magnified views (a2), (b2) and (c2).
In (a1) the phase map is almost entirely green (β-Mn) with only minor red signal, while the paired IPF map shows a fine equiaxed grain structure.
The caption assigns the three low-magnification panels to 525 °C/3 h (a1), 550 °C/6 h (b1) and 650 °C/3 h (c1), with (a2)–(c2) as magnified views.
The caption writes the magnified panels as '(a₂-C2)' while the labels printed in the figure read a2, b2 and c2.
In (a2) black arrows label red islands within the green β-Mn matrix as 'α'.
In (b2) an arrow labels elongated red regions inside green β-Mn as 'New BCC phase', and a separate arrow labels the green matrix 'β-Mn'.
In (c2) black arrows label magenta particles distributed in the matrix as 'New FCC phase'.

The (c2) phase map's matrix appears red/salmon, which under the printed legend would correspond to BCC rather than β-Mn; this conflicts with the caption statement that the FCC phase is distributed in β-Mn — reported as a legend/caption disagreement, low confidence.

The citing text states that after aging at 525 °C for 3 h a significant amount of β-Mn had precipitated (85.8 %), with only a small amount of untransformed α matrix, and hardness rose from 253.4 HV (solid solution) to 872.0 HV.
The citing text states that after 550 °C/6 h the α matrix had almost entirely transformed into β-Mn with a new fine BCC phase inside the β-Mn, matching the 'New BCC phase' label in (b2).
The citing text states that after 650 °C/3 h untransformed α regions were no longer observed and a new FCC phase was distributed in β-Mn, matching the magenta particles labelled in (c2).
No numeric phase fractions or hardness values are printed inside any panel; those numbers appear only in the body text.

subfigures.description: Aging 525 °C/3 h, low magnification. Left: IPF map of fine equiaxed grains in mixed colours, 100 µm scale bar, cubic 001/101/111 key. Right: phase map almost entirely green (β-Mn) with only a few thin red streaks; legend BCC red, α-Mn blue, β-Mn green, FCC magenta.

Magnified view of (a1), 5 µm scale bars. Left: IPF with large blocky colour domains. Right: phase map with green β-Mn matrix containing red islands; black arrows labelled 'α' point to these red regions.

Aging 550 °C/6 h, low magnification, 200 µm scale bars. Left: IPF map with coarse elongated grains, some large red-pink grains. Right: phase map essentially all green β-Mn with sparse small red spots.
Magnified view of (b1), 5 µm scale bars. Left: IPF with mixed coloured domains. Right: phase map of green β-Mn (arrowed 'β-Mn') plus elongated red regions arrowed 'New BCC phase'.

Aging 650 °C/3 h, low magnification, 200 µm scale bars. Left: IPF map of large grains with a white/unindexed band at the left edge. Right: predominantly green phase map with sparse magenta (FCC) speckles and no red.

Magnified view of (c1), 5 µm scale bars. Left: IPF map nearly uniform salmon/pink with a few small differently oriented grains. Right: phase map with a red/salmon base colour and scattered magenta particles pointed at by black arrows labelled 'New FCC phase'.

unreadable_items: panel (c2) phase map: the matrix base colour cannot be reconciled with the printed legend (red = BCC) versus the caption statement that the matrix is β-Mn
panel (c1): the white/unindexed band at the left edge of the IPF map has no accompanying label explaining it
phase fractions are not printed on any panel; the 85.8 % β-Mn value is only in the citing text
